EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2874 and 2907 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and a moderate band at 3301 cm⁻¹ consistent with an O–H stretch (GFQ-001). CH bending/scissoring bands at 1474 and 1441 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and a C–O stretching region band near 1070 cm⁻¹ support a simple alcohol. The absence of a strong N–H bending band near ~1600 cm⁻¹ disfavors primary/secondary amines among other candidates. Methanol (CO) best matches this pattern among the provided options.
